Glory to Kreupasanam Mother and the Holy Trinity. My name is Jeece Varghese. This is my
wife Bincy and our daughter Kesia. The first time we took the covenant was on June 14th, 2023. For the past few
years, we have been living permanently in the United States due to work. Our home
is inherited, and we come from a place called Mamalassery.
Through the intercession of the Holy Mother, we have received countless blessings in our life from Jesus.
We are standing here to bear witness to these blessings. This is our first time visiting here; we came in June
for vacation, and just a few days before my wife was to leave, the Mother
revealed to me, as she had told me, that we should come here, pray, and
dedicate the concerns of our life.
At that moment, as Sister Jomol often says in her meditations, it felt as though everything in life was lost, with no merits left,
standing completely empty-handed, yet holding on firmly, like a grip in a situation where everything else is gone.
Coming and settling in this holy land is something I consider a blessing.
For the first time, it is about my daughter. My daughter is a special kid. Despite many weaknesses and difficulties,
the Mother has been our support and has helped make many improvements in her. Even now, her situation remains under the Mother’s consideration.
I thank the Mother and Jesus for all the improvements given so far.
Secondly, I want to share something about a piece of land transaction. For many years, we were
unable to sell a piece of land because of issues I hadn’t even included in my covenant intentions.
Beyond that, we had more than sixty such issues for all of us.
So I took the covenant, and a few months later, someone we never expected
called my father expressing interest in acquiring our land, right next to our property.
That person said they were interested in obtaining this land.
We did not approach any other buyer. Without telling anyone, without any doubts or difficulties,
the transaction was carried out by the Mother in the smoothest possible way, at the price we mentioned.
For that, I give glory to the Mother Mary and Jesus.
Thirdly, I am an official in the central government in the U.S. While I was working there,
I have been employed in the central government since 2018. My work carries tremendous pressure, even though I am qualified and hold a master’s degree.
I have more than a 10 years of experience. None of that mattered there.
At that time, as our Father always say, it is not by merit,
but by grace. It was only by that grace, by that blessing, that I received a transfer in that job.
I never expected it. I took the covenant, went to the U.S. in September, and a manager I had worked with before
called me there. That person is now a manager in a high position.
He told me that there was a position in his department, and if I was interested, I could apply. At that time,
I had already applied for many positions over the years, attended interviews, and sent my resume to many,
but no one even looked back. All my experience and merit were useless. In that completely empty-handed situation,
I tell everyone: pray, take the covenant, and your matters will proceed. This is a perfect example.
A panel of five people under him interviewed me. I don’t know exactly what was said there,
but simply, I got the job. I am still continuing in that job, and I am very happy there.
It is a job with many challenges, yet I am satisfied. For that, I give thanks to the Mother and Jesus.
Fourthly, in October 2023, my wife had irregular periods. When she underwent scanning,
they found a hernia-type finding in the bile duct, and a cyst in the ovary. At that time, all of this
worried us. As the Father always says, Covenant medal is a weapon; with it in hand, you can proceed.
With that courage, we went for an ultrasound. The doctor said there was no problem, and there was nothing to worry about.
For that blessing from the Mother, we give abundant thanks.
has given us many blessings; there isn’t enough time to describe them all here.
Likewise, one day, after finishing work, my wife and I were returning together, reciting the rosary.
I moved a vehicle aside to go home quickly. A large vehicle came at a terrifying speed toward us.
By a major accident, at that time, the Mother saved us.
That day, I said it was because I had this “weapon” in my hand—the rosary—that we were saved.
That is how we were saved there. Likewise, we continue to face many, many challenges in the family even now.
During the COVID period, we were wishing for a new vehicle.
Because of COVID, vehicles were not available anywhere. We wanted a van in a specific way.
After taking the covenant in June, by November, the vehicle that had been reserved for a friend of mine
went to someone else because that friend got another vehicle. The dealership person called him and said,
“If the vehicle reserved for you can be given to someone else, you can get a good offer.”
That friend felt like calling me, so I went.
The vehicle was exactly what we had wished for. In November itself, we got it without any difficulty.
Now, last but not least, my blood work from last March: for two years I hadn’t done any tests because I was afraid.
Our lifestyle is extremely hectic. Medically speaking, it is a very hectic lifestyle.
We couldn’t properly monitor our health. I hadn’t seen a doctor for two years because of fear.
During COVID, I worked from home, didn’t pay attention to food, and developed a fatty liver problem.
It was called an “upgrade one” condition. I was afraid, so I didn’t get it done.
